page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sgn7i-vws-m8s.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated cloud server instance designed for virtual workstation tasks and entry-level compute acceleration. Built on x86_64 architecture, the instance is powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at 2.9 GHz. It provides 16 vCPUs across 8 physical cores with 2 threads per core, backed by 48 MB of L3 cache and 32 GB of system memory. Graphics and tensor processing are supplied by a 0.3333 fractional NVIDIA A10 GPU allocation with 8 GB of VRAM. Baseline network bandwidth is rated at 5 Gbps, and there is no local instance storage.

Performance benchmarks position the server in the middle tier of general compute and memory capabilities, achieving a PassMark CPU score of 29,573.87 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 12,813.0. Uncached memory bandwidth reaches 77.1 GB/sec for large-block reads and 51.61 GB/sec for writes. Small model LLM inference achieves 243.2 tokens/sec for text generation on a 135M parameter model, dropping to 12.06 tokens/sec on a 7B model. The fractional GPU slice offers a cost-efficient resource partition for workloads requiring moderate graphics or tensor acceleration without full GPU overhead.

This instance profile is suited for virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI), light 3D rendering, computer-aided design (CAD), static web serving, and small-scale AI model inference. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio combined with a partitioned A10 GPU balances general compute density with targeted GPU hardware acceleration.
